owner: One consumed paged collection retains all original children including empty groups through selection, encoding, refusal and close.
selection: Preadmitted paged ordinal cells name only nonempty complete semantic groups; a complete borrowed view can refer only to this same private owned collection.
sourceSwap: No second caller collection argument is accepted at view construction; source identity cannot change between selection and encoding.
emptyGroups: Filtering publication never removes or drops an original empty child's metadata, labels or physical pages.
refusal: Cancellation and index-page admission refusal preserve all child owners and every actual selection page.
close: One actual ordinal/child/nested page step under1item/4096; no incomplete child wrapper is dropped.
parent: Genuine empty page handback forwards the actual selection and child allocations to the preadmitted parent, with zero child physical disposal credit.
